name: i.safe MOBILE IS530.1
statusNote: i.safe MOBILE has moved it to the archive section of its range, but distributors still list it. Check availability before ordering.
summary: The i.safe MOBILE IS530.1 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ib) smartphone from i.safe MOBILE, certified for Zone 1/21 under ATEX and IECEx, and for Class I Division 1 in North America. It runs Android 13, with a user-replaceable battery.

atex.marking: II 2G Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / II 2D Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db IP6X

iecex.marking: Ex ib IIC T4 Gb / Ex ib IIIC T135°C Db IP6X

certification.northAmerica: NEC/CEC 70220251: Class I Div 1, Class II Div 1, Class III

safety.conditions: Approved battery BPIS530.1 only (per IA certificate); i.safe devices are generally charged outside the hazardous area only - confirm in IS530.1 manual

variants.name: IS530.M1
variants.description: Mining version with Group I approval. i.safe's safety instructions and IECEx certificate also list the Zone 1/21 rating, but its datasheet shows the mining approval only.
variants.marking: I M1 Ex ia I Ma IP64

unconfirmed.os.version: Resellers list Android 13; i.safe MOBILE's datasheet gives Android 10 at launch.

strengths: ATEX and IECEx certified, with published certificate numbers
Also certified for Class I Division 1 in North America
A mining version (Group I) is also available
Barcode scan module available as an accessory
limitations: May be near the end of its life: check availability before ordering
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
No published end date for security updates
